name: gui_graph_order
description: GL-5d, decision 1, on a fixture of its own: Blank's rendering section has one pass, so gui_graph_only_edits cannot reach Order… from Blank. The root's rendering section holds left, right and present (fullscreen passes with engine://passthrough). right picked on the Graph offers Order… in its detail column; it is the Frame Plan's Order..., which reads the plan again first (the Frame Plan's tab is never brought forward) and opens the Features tab's node order dialog on the plan's nodes. Apply sends that order: get_frame_node_order keeps it, the root holds frame_node_order, the plan and the picture do not change. A swap of left and right is not tried: the engine chains a canonical bucket's passes in their declared order (enforceCanonicalOrder), so any reorder of the rendering section's passes is refused as a dependency cycle (reported). Nothing typed.
